correctness.rationale: Projector identity Q=−(a+b)(I−Π), exact Padé eigenfactor (6−2s)/(s²+4s+6), positive denominator and strictly positive off-diagonals yield one precise quadratic sign criterion. Discriminant, roots, critical tangency, asymptotic opening, and equality cases are established algebraically. For s>0 both 1−r and 1+r are strictly positive, implying strict stationary-weighted contraction and strict positivity of T². The exact rational witness and 3360 rational direct reconstructions passed. Finite tests are not used as proof of universal quantifiers.

originality.rationale: Full primary energy-law and diagonal Padé positivity literature plus mathematical statements of the three closest exact published Markov-RK theorems were checked for implication. None covers the specific [1/2] two-state Markov phase transition with sharp 5+3√3 rate ratio and disconnected positivity set. General contractivity and large-step qualitative positivity are credited, not claimed original. Inaccessible specialized historical papers and a plausible 2026 Fokker–Planck source leave residual priority uncertainty. A search failure is not proof of global uniqueness.
residual_risks: Full text of Itkin–Kazbek arXiv:2608.22703 was not accessible in the attempted routes; broader results may imply part of the eventual positivity conclusion.
Full primary texts of Horváth 1998 and 2005 were not recovered, so a more specialized fixed-generator theorem could coincide with part or all of the exact classification.
The theorem has not been independently audited or priority-certified.

value.rationale: A probability propagator must preserve the Markov simplex, not merely contract an energy norm. The exact rate-ratio threshold, two disjoint admissible step ranges and guaranteed strict positivity after two identical steps characterize a real parameter-selection trade-off for a canonical third-order L-stable stiff solver. The sharp square-root onset and coincident transition matrices at two distant step sizes show structured nonmonotone behavior absent from generic contractivity statements. This is a complete classification of a natural minimal test object, not a routine numerical gain or arbitrary slice.
